title: [CmdPal] Dock apps configured in the centre position do not render after system restart until hovered/edited

judgment.rationale: Track the concrete existing visibility fix rather than propose the same Loaded callback again. Do not mark the report resolved: absent provider commands and present-but-hidden center items are different branches, and the archive contains evidence of the former. Reproduce the reported sequence while checking which branch applies, then coordinate a regression/follow-up through the existing dock owner.
evidence: The report gives a complete Top dock / center apps / reboot / hover-or-edit recovery sequence on 0.102.2933 and supplies a diagnostic ZIP.
The supplied CmdPal log records SetupBands failing to find the pinned Discord and Spotify commands from AllApps, both at startup and again about ten minutes later.
Merged PR #50755 already adds UpdateCenterVisibility on DockControl.Loaded for the missed-collection-notification race; that call is present in current main.

actions.label: Separate hidden center items from unresolved startup app bands

reproduce.title: Separate hidden center items from unresolved startup app bands
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported 0.102.2933 and a build containing merged #50755/current main.
prerequisites: Use an isolated test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: 1. Using the supplied dock settings, configure Top with the reported center app entries; reboot or reproduce a controlled cold sign-in.
2. Before hover/edit, record CenterItems count, ContentGrid.IsCenterVisible and whether each saved command resolves from AllApps.
3. Hover and enter/exit edit mode; compare visibility and band-resolution state without deleting or re-pinning the entries.
4. Repeat with a stable built-in center band and with deliberately delayed app-provider discovery, then a monitor rebuild.
reproduce.expected_result: Existing center bands render immediately; unresolved providers are distinguished from hidden existing items and recover when legitimately available without requiring an edit interaction.
